svg.title: PandaPay SMS categorization: actual input, rule, AI, review and learning paths
svg.desc: Top: acquisition, safety and identity, local parsing. Three lanes: raw transaction import, typed financial facts, and eligible unresolved AI review. Bottom: user correction, reviewed shared category and parser learning, approved downloads. Explicit negative AI decisions bypass the positive-fact confidence threshold.
svg.text: Source audit: 1 Nov 2026 · solid arrows = processing · dashed arrows = fallback / learning · click a block for its section

a.aria-label: Read section 3: 1 Acquire the original message
a.text: Android inbox / live / background · iOS Shortcuts + native spool / history · SMS backup XML
Core input: sender + original body + receivedAt; namespace is separate. Provider/spool IDs track transport progress.

a.aria-label: Read section 4: 2 Filter, identify and deduplicate
a.text: 20,000-character bound → OTP / credential veto → sender / P2P / demat / promotion / financial triage
Sensitive: stop before persistence. Clear noise: adapter drop, or minimal decision if capture store is reached.
SHA256(profile + normalized sender + normalized body); receipt/parser-version checks; private ignore-layout rule.

a.aria-label: Read section 5: 3 Resolve sender and source evidence
a.text: Missing sender + plausible financial text → local sender_unavailable review; no automatic upload or financial effects.
Saved cards / suffix / instrument type + profile name support attribution; an account suffix is not a card suffix.
Receipt time is excluded from source identity: identical alerts across separate occurrences can collapse.

a.aria-label: Read section 6: 4 Parse and save on device
a.text: Built-in safety + special families → approved downloaded rules → built-in grammar; parser version 26.
Category: private correction → semantic override (built-in path) → scoped shared rule → merchant trie.
Atomic save: decision / reason / parser+bundle version / observation; optional provisional transaction, bill or commitment.
Candidate rules: independent baseline comparison; shadow records deltas, eligible apply candidates may replace output.
Local inferred category is not sent as

a.aria-label: Read section 9: Needs Review → AI job

a.text: and eligible AI handoff in lane C.

a.aria-label: Read section 8: Validate and resolve facts

a.text: Successful parsing does not trigger AI.
No invented spend from a ceiling/balance
Unconfirmed AI facts do not become

a.aria-label: Read section 10: Validation and one repair pass
a.text: One AI repair on validation errors
amounts can evade this repair trigger.

a.aria-label: Read section 6: Local UI / source ownership
Read section 10: Server score + device recheck
a.text: and applies latest private category rule.

a.aria-label: Read section 14: What can still go wrong?
a.text: Prior bad history reinforces a label
Category is not a calibrated parse score
Undo AI filing; keep source editable

svg.text: LEARNING LOOP · personal corrections are immediate; cross-user improvements need consent and review

a.text: User correction wins over local AI
A local AI ID is not a server txn ID.
Latest scoped user votes; consent lineage

a.aria-label: Read section 11: Approved rule refresh feeds future eligible captures
a.text: Approved rule refresh feeds future eligible captures
GET /sms/rules/active → validate version / minimum client / checksum → keep last valid cached rules offline
Personal corrections retain precedence. Experiments require consent. Rule refresh is not a blanket historical replay.
No automatic second model on every import; polling reads the existing job; failed jobs need bounded retry or explicit action.

svg.text: REPRODUCED GAP: an available-limit amount can pass as the posted charge.
₹499 spend + ₹45,000 available limit → a wrong ₹45,000 fact passes JS evidence and scores .995. Synthetic probe; sections 13–16.
